messages.subject: data format for binary variable
parts:
Hi Paul,

I am working on a model with a binary response and all binary predictor variables. I am wondering if the format of these data (numeric, factor, character etc) affects the way brms handles them. Is there a preferred format for binary? 

Thanks,

Daniel
